title: Integrately Free Plan in 2026: Limits and Alternatives
summary: The integrately free plan allows 100 tasks monthly across 5 automations. Verify current limits on integrately.com/pricing before committing.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Does Integrately delete my workflows if I stay on the free plan?


We found no vendor statement that Integrately deletes workflows because you stay on free. The limit that bites is the task allowance, so the real question is what happens to a live automation once that allowance is used up.


Read the plan terms for that before you build anything a customer or a teammate depends on. If the terms don't say, treat it as undefined and keep a written copy of each workflow's steps.


### Can I export Integrately workflows to another tool?


Assume you can't, unless the vendor documents an export or import path. Each platform builds its automations from its own connectors and its own step logic, so moving usually means rebuilding.


Multiply the number of automations you run by the time each takes to recreate and test, and that is the cost.


Move a small set and it costs little; move a large one and it doesn't. Keeping a plain-language record of each trigger, action and field mapping makes any later move faster.


### Is there a truly unlimited free automation tool?


Among the hosted tools compared in this article, none is free without a meter. Each caps something: tasks, operations, runs, steps or how often it checks for new data.


Self-host and the vendor's cloud cap goes away, but then your server, updates and backups become the cost. "Unlimited" in that case means you carry the limit yourself, in time and hardware, instead of paying for it.


### Do free plans include premium apps?


It depends on the vendor, and you should check app by app. Some platforms reserve certain connectors for paid tiers, so a free plan can cover the apps you need or leave out the one that matters most.


Look up the single app your workflow can't work without, on the vendor's own app listing or pricing page, before you build around it. If that app is gated, the free plan's task allowance is irrelevant to you.
